@fixation_limit : ∀ {N : ℕ} {P : Fin (N + 1) → Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
  AbsorbingChain P →
    0 < N →
      ∀ {h : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
        InteriorHarmonic P h →
          h 0 = 0 →
            h (Fin.last N) = 1 →
              (∀ (k : Fin (N + 1)), 0 < ↑k → ↑k < N → 0 < ∑ j, P k j * (h j - h k) ^ 2) →
                ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)),
                  Tendsto (fun n => kPow P n i (Fin.last N)) atTop (𝓝 (h i)) ∧
                    Tendsto (fun n => kPow P n i 0) atTop (𝓝 (1 - h i))
@harmonic_unique_of_var : ∀ {N : ℕ} {P : Fin (N + 1) → Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
  AbsorbingChain P →
    0 < N →
      ∀ {h : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
        InteriorHarmonic P h →
          h 0 = 0 →
            h (Fin.last N) = 1 →
              (∀ (k : Fin (N + 1)), 0 < ↑k → ↑k < N → 0 < ∑ j, P k j * (h j - h k) ^ 2) →
                ∀ {g : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
                  InteriorHarmonic P g → g 0 = 0 → g (Fin.last N) = 1 → ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)), g i = h i
@wright_fisher_fixation_limit : ∀ {N : ℕ},
  0 < N →
    ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)),
      Tendsto (fun n => kPow (AutoresearchPopGen.wfP N) n i (Fin.last N)) atTop (𝓝 (↑↑i / ↑N)) ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => kPow (AutoresearchPopGen.wfP N) n i 0) atTop (𝓝 (1 - ↑↑i / ↑N))
@moran_fixation_limit : ∀ {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
  0 < N →
    0 < r →
      ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)),
        Tendsto (fun n => kPow (moranP N r) n i (Fin.last N)) atTop (𝓝 (moranFix N r ↑i)) ∧
          Tendsto (fun n => kPow (moranP N r) n i 0) atTop (𝓝 (1 - moranFix N r ↑i))
@moran_fixation_limit_closed : ∀ {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
  0 < N →
    0 < r →
      r ≠ 1 →
        ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)),
          Tendsto (fun n => kPow (moranP N r) n i (Fin.last N)) atTop (𝓝 ((1 - r⁻¹ ^ ↑i) / (1 - r⁻¹ ^ N)))
@moran_fixation_limit_neutral : ∀ {N : ℕ},
  0 < N → ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)), Tendsto (fun n => kPow (moranP N 1) n i (Fin.last N)) atTop (𝓝 (↑↑i / ↑N))
@moran_fixation_unique : ∀ {N : ℕ} {r : ℝ},
  0 < N →
    0 < r →
      ∀ {g : Fin (N + 1) → ℝ},
        InteriorHarmonic (moranP N r) g → g 0 = 0 → g (Fin.last N) = 1 → ∀ (i : Fin (N + 1)), g i = moranFix N r ↑i
@moran_closed_tendsto_neutral : ∀ {N : ℕ},
  0 < N → ∀ (i : ℕ), Tendsto (fun r => (1 - r⁻¹ ^ i) / (1 - r⁻¹ ^ N)) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 (↑i / ↑N))
@price_equation : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] (s : Finset ι) (n w z z' : ι → K),
  ∑ i ∈ s, n i ≠ 0 →
    ∑ i ∈ s, n i * w i ≠ 0 →
      wmean s n w * (zbarNext s n w z' - wmean s n z) = wcov s n w z + wmean s n fun i => w i * (z' i - z i)

  ∑ i ∈ s, n i ≠ 0 → ∑ i ∈ s, n i * w i ≠ 0 → wbarNext s n w - wmean s n w = wvar s n w / wmean s n w

  s.Nonempty →
    (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < n i) →
